note: Summaries are new working interpretations of two draft story seeds, not quoted canon; neither source has granted character crossover rights.

threads.title: The train without an imposed ending

source.basis: Interpretation of the six-page authored manga proposal, especially the train passengers and blank ticket.

arc.desire: allow the passengers to complete or continue by their own choice
arc.relationship: protection without possession of another person's future
arc.conflict: the Forecloser orders an ending without asking those inside
arc.choice: leave the destination blank and make room for individual decisions
arc.consequence: the train unfolds and the case retains a truthful record
arc.remainder: which possible future survives an ending imposed by someone else?

constraints: no character can decide another's destination merely by recognizing the case

threads.title: A door that cannot command anyone
threads.world: THE ROOM INSIDE THE ROOM (incubating multimedia seed)

source.revision: GitBook page YOaPU4jrJFIXFal6hIr7, read 2026-10-16; immutable revision not independently recovered
source.basis: Interpretation of the bounded two-rat doorway example and the explicit crossing-availability constraint.

participants: Two rats separated by an experimental habitat

arc.desire: make a possible route available for animals to reunite
arc.relationship: a maker's responsibility to offer passage without treating passengers as commands
arc.conflict: the engine constructs a door while one rat waits for the other
arc.choice: leave the passage available without forcing a crossing
arc.consequence: waiting itself changes what the human helpers notice
arc.remainder: what does a route mean when the person or animal it serves refuses to move?

constraints: passage availability does not imply perception, consent, or crossing
the animal's refusal is a meaningful action
